description: Least privilege for the main window. Granted: the IPC commands shards_call and shards_open (opens one vault file in Obsidian, the default app or Finder after a space-root check in Rust), change events (listen/unlisten for vault://changed), the overlay titlebar drag region (start dragging, double-click maximize), and opening http(s)/mailto/tel links in the default app (the opener plugin intercepts target=_blank links). Not granted: host_pick_vault (no UI calls it yet), dialog, window-state and every other core API; the Rust side uses those plugins directly. No fs scope: all vault IO goes through shards_call.
